issues.description: In problem_statement.md is an additional requirement to implement `init_world(width, height)` (set world dimensions). This function is unrelated to the actual Hello-World ASM task (changing `ecc` to `ecx`) and is not present in the template. The solution repository introduces an `init_world:` label, but it only reads a single argument (`[esp+4]`) and ignores `height`, so even the reference solution does not match the stated two-parameter requirement. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they must implement `init_world` and with which parameters/behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the `init_world(width, height)` requirement from problem_statement.md for this Hello-World exercise. Alternatively, if `init_world` is intended, add an explicit stub in template `helloWorld.asm` and adjust the reference solution so `init_world` consumes both parameters (width and height) as described (and document where/how it is called).
